results.name: 3D Journal Page Carousel
results.description: 3D journal page carousel: an open scrapbook spread in the middle with earlier and later pages standing edge-on in two receding stacks. Drag, flick, click a page or use the arrow keys to turn; each turn swings the next spread in and folds the last one shut. Polaroids, taped prints and handwritten notes sit on each page, and it auto-advances until touched.
results.author: kedhareswer

results.name: Sneaker Product Page Hero
results.description: Sneaker product page hero: a product-detail section for one shoe in several colourways, with a floating shoe and reflection, hold-to-zoom loupe, size, colour and stock picker, animated price and add-to-cart with a like burst. For ecommerce product pages.

results.name: Silk Shader Hero Background

results.name: Animated Stripe Hero Section
results.description: Animated stripe hero section: a striped card lit by slow light beams that flare under the pointer, with a serif headline, counting stats, a drifting logo band and a statement that lights up word by word on scroll. For SaaS and logistics landing pages.

results.name: Animated Sticker Headline Hero
results.description: Animated sticker headline hero: a poster-weight headline whose last word keeps swapping, as the round photo sticker pops off, the word rolls to the next one and a new sticker pops into the gap. For landing pages and brand heroes.

results.name: LED Dot Matrix Chart Card
results.description: LED dot matrix chart card: a revenue card whose chart is a board of LED dots, lighting each day's column from the bottom with a bright top dot, sweeping on in view while the total rolls up like an odometer. For dashboards and sales stats.

results.name: 3D Fold Fullscreen Menu

results.name: Scroll Stacking Cards
results.description: Scroll stacking cards: full-bleed photo cards pile up as the page scrolls, each arriving tilted and landing flat while the ones below tip back, shrink and darken, with a counter and progress rail. For tours, case studies and product stories.

results.name: Scroll Rotating Product Slider
results.description: Scroll rotating product slider: a big top-down photo turns and morphs into the next as the page scrolls, while the background colour blends, a dot glides round a ring of curved names and corner garnish swaps. For menus, bakeries and product ranges.

results.name: Food Menu Scroll Carousel
results.description: Food menu scroll carousel: page scroll swings each plate out on an orbit as the next swings in, with a wiping two-weight title, chef card and a colour-morphing band. Endless both ways, GSAP ScrollTrigger, light/dark.

results.name: Scroll Split Product Slider
results.description: Scroll-driven split-screen product slider: each scroll step lifts the copy out line by line, then the next photo slides over the last and turns square. Snaps, loops both ways, round seam thumbnails. GSAP ScrollTrigger, light and dark.

results.name: Runway Fashion Lookbook Carousel
results.description: Runway fashion lookbook carousel: the collection's looks queue up in depth across a catwalk, and scrolling walks the next model forward into focus while the rest blur behind. A look counter, shop-the-look link and a side rail of pieces with prices.

results.name: Flipping Website Screenshot Deck

results.author: kedhareswer

results.name: Craft Beer Product Landing Page Template
results.description: Craft beer product landing page template for an Indian brewery's monsoon IPA: the bottle rides the scroll on a sticky layer while the hero, tasting notes, brewing story, food pairings and a where-to-buy section move past it, all choreographed with GSAP.

results.name: Design Studio Agency Landing Page
results.description: Design studio agency landing page for a team that works with SaaS startups, seen from beneath a forest canopy: amber autumn trees ring the sky behind the headline, with rotating words, client logos, work, services, process, pricing, FAQ and a booking call to action. Built with GSAP and ScrollTrigger.
results.author: kedhareswer

results.description: Page flip recipe book template: a coffee-table book of biryani legends that turns its pages as you scroll. Keys, swipe and a contents page included.

results.author: kedhareswer

results.name: Henna Shop Ecommerce Template
results.description: Henna shop ecommerce template: a working storefront for an organic henna house dressed like a mehndi wedding card, maroon, olive and burnished gold on parchment with damask grounds, brocade borders, Mughal arches and mandalas. results.name: AI Voice Agent Landing Page
